provenanceLimitation: The exact rendered snapshot hash was not recorded. This review describes an earlier candidate and does not evidence the final 48-master set.

families.sameObjectReason: All three tiers preserve a facing-page publication with small illustrated content blocks.

siblingCollision.reason: Both families read as open two-page publications, especially at 16px where the pencil and page-content distinctions are weak.

families.backgroundAmbiguity: Low. The dark page outlines hold on all three backgrounds, though the white page fields flatten slightly on white.

families.sameObjectReason: The folded panels, green terrain marks, and orange corner marker remain consistent across tiers.

siblingCollision.reason: No other family presents the same folded-map silhouette.

families.backgroundAmbiguity: Low. The cream, green, and dark contour remain distinct on teal, chrome, and white.

families.sameObjectReason: Each tier shows a single lavender sheet with horizontal writing and a folded lower corner.

siblingCollision.reason: At 16px both can read as a small single sheet of paper before the writing and attachment details resolve.

families.backgroundAmbiguity: Low. The lavender fill keeps the note separate from every background, with only the 16px writing becoming indistinct.

families.sameObjectReason: The same frontal head, brown skin, dark hair, and glasses become progressively more explicit at larger tiers.

siblingCollision.reason: No other family uses a standalone human-head silhouette.

families.backgroundAmbiguity: Low. The face remains outlined and distinct across backgrounds, although facial identity is not reliable at 16px.

families.sameObjectReason: All tiers retain the beige display casing, glass screen, base, and small indicator.

siblingCollision.reason: Both families center on a beige CRT monitor; F016 separates only when its red audio marks are noticed.

families.backgroundAmbiguity: Low. The dark outline preserves the monitor silhouette on teal, chrome, and white.

families.sameObjectReason: The overlapping rectangular frames and front content panel remain in the same arrangement at every tier.

siblingCollision.reason: Both use blue-topped application-window imagery; the stacked rear windows are the main distinction.

families.backgroundAmbiguity: Medium. Teal separates the layered backs most clearly, while pale frame edges merge more with chrome and white.

families.sameObjectReason: The page silhouette is stable; the blue paperclip and document lines are omitted or compressed at the smallest tier.

siblingCollision.reason: The 16px forms are both single paper sheets, with neither the clip nor writing pattern strong enough for immediate separation.

families.backgroundAmbiguity: Medium. The blank 16px page has little internal signal, and white reduces its fill contrast despite the dark outline.

families.sameObjectReason: Every tier shows a horizontal credential with a portrait block and text lines; the top clip becomes clearer at larger sizes.

siblingCollision.reason: Both contain a small blue-accented profile/content panel, especially similar before the badge clip resolves.

families.backgroundAmbiguity: Medium. The badge outline survives all backgrounds, but the portrait is nearly unreadable at 16px and weak on chrome.

families.sameObjectReason: The dark rectangular frame, blue title bar, and white profile-content panel are progressively simplified versions of one window.

siblingCollision.reason: Both read as blue-topped desktop windows; F009 is distinguished mainly by having one frame rather than a visible stack.

families.backgroundAmbiguity: Medium. The single-window shape is clearest on teal; its pale body and frame flatten somewhat on chrome and white, especially at 16px.

families.sameObjectReason: The framed rectangle persists, while the pale mountain forms and yellow sun appear clearly only at the larger tiers.

siblingCollision.reason: At 16px the pale triangular landscape can read as an envelope flap, making it resemble the mail family.

families.backgroundAmbiguity: Medium. The 16px noun is ambiguous on all backgrounds, and white further reduces contrast in the pale landscape area.

families.sameObjectReason: The same three tan forms recur in matching positions, but their shared object identity remains unclear at every tier.

siblingCollision.reason: The disconnected tan forms do not closely match another family, even though their own noun is unclear.

families.backgroundAmbiguity: High. Without a containing silhouette, the tan forms look like unrelated fragments on chrome and white and only slightly more grouped on teal.

families.sameObjectReason: The envelope, raised paper insert, and blue header remain consistent, with detail increasing by tier.

siblingCollision.reason: The tiny envelope and the tiny landscape image both contain a pale rectangle crossed by diagonal forms.

families.backgroundAmbiguity: Low. The dark envelope outline carries across backgrounds, though the inserted letter is difficult to parse at 16px.

families.sameObjectReason: All tiers preserve the open spread and orange writing tool along the center fold, with page graphics added at size.

siblingCollision.reason: Both use an open-book silhouette and small page graphics; the central pencil is not fully separating at 16px.

families.backgroundAmbiguity: Medium. The dark contour keeps the book visible, but its white pages blend into white and the center tool is tiny on chrome.

families.sameObjectReason: The yellow spiral-bound pad and teal writing marks persist, while the pencil becomes explicit at 32px.

siblingCollision.reason: Both imply writing in a book with an orange tool, though the spiral-bound single pad separates well at 24px and 32px.

families.backgroundAmbiguity: Low. The saturated yellow notepad remains distinct on every background; only the 16px writing marks compress.

families.brandReading: file manager, portfolio, or photo archive
families.sameObjectReason: The yellow folder silhouette is constant, with inserted image sheets appearing more explicitly at larger tiers.

siblingCollision.reason: No sibling combines the same tabbed yellow container with papers protruding from it.

families.backgroundAmbiguity: Low. The saturated folder remains readable on teal, chrome, and white; only its contents disappear at 16px.

families.sameObjectReason: Every tier combines the same CRT monitor with red musical notes to its right.

siblingCollision.reason: The base monitor is nearly the same noun; recognition depends on noticing the red musical notes.

families.backgroundAmbiguity: Low. The monitor outline and red notes stay visible across all three backgrounds, though the smallest notes are easy to miss.
